amendments.reason: The changes bullet said create replay requires the key to "still be absent" without naming the snapshot, and the rubric reads that as the latest snapshot. canReplayEdit actually tests the BASE snapshot (!Object.hasOwn(before, edit.key)), leaving FEATURE_EXISTS on re-application to catch a key taken meanwhile. The phase goal is to document what the code does, so the bullet is made explicit rather than the comment made wrong.
amendments.grounding: packages/dashboard/src/domain/flag-edit.ts, canReplayEdit line: `if (edit.kind === create) return !Object.hasOwn(before, edit.key);` — before is featuresIn(baseText).

changes: create -> the key must still be absent
create -> the key must have been absent in the BASE snapshot; the latest is not checked, and re-applying the edit reports FEATURE_EXISTS if someone else took the key meanwhile
